la:other:eheu.html:
ēheu, interj., an interjection of pain or grief,
ah! alas! ; ; ; ; ; ; .—Often followed by quam: eheu, quam ego nunc totus displiceo mihi,; . (The epic and lyric poets have everywhere ēheu; and hence many moderns, partly in accordance with better MSS., read everywhere heu heu; cf. Burmann, Voss, Wagner, and Ribbeck,; also Forbig. ad loc.; Hand Turs. 2, 358 sq.; Sillig ; Huschk. ; Fea and Keller,; but in , and 2, 14, 1 al. the best editions have ēheu.)

ĕhŏ, interj.; in the comic poets, used in asking, commanding, or scolding,
ha? ho! holla! soho!
